name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Per-gamemode input buffer. F6 intensity, F7 per-gamemode logic, F8 on-screen display, hold a key to pause the buffer.

wave-ms.name: Wave
wave-ms.description: Input delay in wave. Higher = more forgiving, less direct control.

ship-ms.name: Ship
ship-ms.description: 0 keeps the ship fully raw so it never feels sluggish.

flat-ms.name: Flat delay (when F7 situational is OFF)
flat-ms.description: Single delay used for every gamemode when per-gamemode logic is toggled off with F7.

transition-percent.name: Transition boost (%)
transition-percent.description: Delay multiplier right after a portal or gravity flip. 100 = no boost.

speed-scaling.name: Scale by speed
speed-scaling.description: Use less delay at higher speeds.

max-ms.name: Maximum delay (ms)
max-ms.description: Hard cap no matter what the other settings produce.

hold-disable-key.name: Hold-to-disable key
hold-disable-key.description: While you hold this key, the buffer is paused and inputs are raw. Release to turn it back on.

debug-hud.name: Show debug panel
debug-hud.description: Shows internal counters under the stage text. Used to diagnose problems.
